messages:
Marta: Opening a coordination thread: we need to standardize a few overlapping terms before the next docs sweep (conversation vs session, prompt vs input, response vs output). Link to proposal: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/630
Marta: High level goal: pick one canonical term per concept + mapping for UI, SDK, CLI, and error text. Keep UI short, SDK idiomatic.
Anshu: Quick preferences from docs: use "conversation" for long-lived contexts, "session" only for auth/session tokens. Use "input" as the API param name, "prompt" in higher-level guides.
Sam: Product note: Console uses "session" in telemetry and routes, changing that might affect analytics. We should gate any Console rename with product + analytics sign-off.
Priya: For SDKs: decide casing rules per language. Proposal: Python = snake_case, JS = camelCase, Go = PascalCase for exported fields, CLI = --kebab-case.
Jin: Agreed. I'll add tests in the SDK test-suite to assert both canonical and legacy aliases map to the same internal field. Also emit a deprecation log for one release.
Marcos: For the docs sweep, we should run a token-cost check. If we rename UI labels that affect prompts, ensure we update example prompts used in evals and benchmarks.
Marta: Good catch. Add to checklist: update eval prompt corpus if phrase changes.
Anshu: Decision about error text: keep imperative tone, avoid polite requests and contractions. Example: "Attach a valid API key" not "Please attach your API key". Add that to the style guide.
Priya: Small edge: "input" in SDKs vs "prompt" in tutorial prose. We should include a short sentence in the glossary explaining mapping ("input (SDK) corresponds to prompt (guide)").
Sam: Approvers for final canonical list: Docs leads (Marta + Anshu) + Product PM (Sam) + Console lead (Priya) if Console labels change.
Marta: Proposed lightweight migration checklist in the PR: 
- [ ] Author canonical list + rationale column
- [ ] Generate repo-wide map CSV (context, path, breaking?)
- [ ] Bulk docs replace (non-code) + CI spellcheck
- [ ] Console PRs for UI label changes (with analytics review)
- [ ] SDK PRs: aliases + deprecation warnings + tests
- [ ] Update evals and benchmarks
- [ ] Release notes and contributor guide blurb
- [ ] Wait one release, then remove aliases
Priya: For Console, please include screenshots of changed labels when opening the PR so design can quickly confirm token fits.
Jin: Example SDK snippets we should include in the PR description:
```js
// JS (old)
client.generate({ prompt: 'Summarize...', conversationId: 'c1' })
// JS (new)
client.generate({ input: 'Summarize...', conversation: 'c1' })
```
```py
# Python (old)
resp = client.generate(prompt='Hello')
# Python (new)
resp = client.generate(input='Hello')
```
Marcos: For Go clients, export field rename example:
```go
// old
req := GenerateRequest{Prompt: "Hello"}
// new
req := GenerateRequest{Input: "Hello"}
```
Anshu: Make sure to include both the old and new examples in the same code block with comments about deprecation timeline. Readers should see how to migrate.
Marta: docs-bot: link PR 630 to docs-workflow
docs-bot: PR #630 linked to docs-workflow board
Priya: I created a short contributor guide blurb draft and posted it here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#canonical-phrases
Marta: Nice. Jin, can you produce the mapping CSV by EOD PST (2148003000)? Include columns: found_phrase, canonical, context, repo_path, breaking_yes_no, rationale.
Jin: Yup, will include a sample of 50 rows and mark breaking ones.
Sam: For analytics: if Console label changes, we'll keep a transient mapping in telemetry pipelines for three releases to reconcile historical dashboards. I'll coordinate offline with analytics infra.
Marcos: Reminder: run the docs link-checker after replacements; some internal anchors change if headings are renamed.
Anshu: For the glossary page, let's include synonyms and a short usage note (e.g., "Use 'input' in code, 'prompt' in conceptual guides"). Keep entries concise.
Marta: Volunteers for quick PR review? I can do docs + glossary. Priya will do Console. Jin + Marcos will handle SDK + tests. Sam will review product/analytics concerns.
Marta: Closing coordination thread. If anything blocks migration, reopen. Thanks everyone!
